name: Elihu
summary: Elihu the son of Barachel was a young man who waited while Job and his three friends spoke, then grew angry with them all. He spoke on God's behalf, telling Job that God is greater than man.

key_moments.title: Speaks Up After the Others Fall Silent
key_moments.description: When Job's three friends stopped answering him, Elihu grew angry with Job for justifying himself rather than God, and with the friends for condemning Job with no answer. He had waited because they were older, but now he said that age does not always bring wisdom.

key_moments.title: Tells Job God Is Greater Than Man
key_moments.description: Elihu told Job he had heard him say he was clean and without sin. He answered that Job was not right in this, for God is greater than man and speaks once, even twice, though man does not see it.

key_moments.title: Points Job to God's Wonders
key_moments.description: Elihu told Job to be still and think about the wonders God does in the clouds and the sky. He said God is clothed in awesome majesty, and the Almighty is beyond finding out.
